# Absolute Group Inc.

> Asset-based cross-border trucking carrier based in Laredo, Texas (since 2011). Full truckload (FTL), door-to-door freight, border crossing, expedited freight, warehousing and transloading between Mexico and the United States. C-TPAT certified, FAST lane access, 200+ power units, 24/7 satellite tracking. Bilingual service (English / Spanish).

Contact: (956) 727-6004 · contact@absolute-fi.com · 1208 Vidal Cantu Rd., Laredo, TX 78045, USA

## Services (English)

- [Freight & Cross-Border Services](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services): Overview of all services
- [Full Truckload (FTL)](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services/full-truckload-ftl): Dedicated 53 ft dry van FTL between Mexico and the U.S.
- [Cross-Border Freight](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services/cross-border-freight): Border crossing through Laredo, TX without third-party transfers
- [Door-to-Door Freight](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services/door-to-door-freight): Same trailer from Mexico pickup to U.S. delivery, no transloading
- [Expedited Freight](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services/expedited-freight): Time-critical freight with dual-driver teams
- [Warehousing & Cross-Docking](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services/warehousing): Storage, cross-docking, loading and unloading in Laredo, TX
- [Transloading](https://www.absolute-fi.com/en/services/transloading): Rail-to-truck and truck-to-rail transfers
